shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure carved in the round
human head with rendered eyes, nose and mouth
arms/limbs held close against a blocky body
incised linear surface decoration on the body (bands, hatching, geometric motifs)
headgear or covering over the head/shoulders
justification: Both depict a blocky, massive anthropomorphic figure carved in the round whose plain volumes are overlaid with shallow incised geometric detail (bands, hatched fields, motifs on the torso/shoulder) and whose limbs are pressed tight against the body, a broadly comparable sculptural convention. They differ in the specific iconography and pose: A is a strictly frontal, upright figure with a broad head-covering and distinct emblematic discs and bands laid out symmetrically down the chest, while B shows a hunched or crouching figure seen obliquely with a strongly modelled projecting face, a bent limb across the body and a crosshatched textured field, with a second head-like mass above.
